scope: controlled in-process Lightyear server plus two primary-client Lightyear clients
reached_endpoint: both clients received S2CPhaseChanged(DraftInitial); server room state reached GameActive and RoundState reached DraftInitial

phases.host: C2SHello sent; S2CHandshake received with stable PlayerId
phases.joiner: C2SHello sent; S2CHandshake received with stable PlayerId
phases.server: PlayerConnectionMap contained both fresh primary-client peers

phases.host_response: S2CRoomCreated received; room code captured as <ROOM_CODE_6_CHARS>

phases.joiner: C2SJoinRoom sent with captured room code and slot 1

phases.responses: both clients received S2CClassLocked for their own class
both clients received S2CClassesRevealed with two player/class entries
phases.authority: class map came from server RoomSessions/ClassSelections state

phases.server: ready room promoted to GameActive; SessionConfig and ServerRng inserted; RoundState entered DraftInitial
